channel.title: 101 Tech Labs — Engineering Notes
channel.description: Real technical writing on the decisions behind full-stack applications.

item.title: RS256 vs HS256: Choosing a JWT Signing Algorithm for Multi-Tenant Systems
item.description: HS256 and RS256 solve the same problem differently — one shares a secret, one doesn’t. Here’s why that distinction matters more once more than one service needs to verify a token.

item.title: A Backend & Identity Glossary: JWT, JWKS, Multi-Tenancy, and More
item.description: Plain definitions for the terms that come up most when talking about authentication and multi-tenant backend architecture — not a complete course, a working reference.

item.title: argon2id vs bcrypt vs scrypt: Choosing a Password Hashing Algorithm
item.description: Three real options for hashing passwords, what actually separates them, and why argon2id is the current default recommendation — not a trend, a specific set of tradeoffs.

item.title: In-House vs. Outsourced Backend Engineering: What Actually Changes
item.description: The tradeoff isn’t cost vs. quality — it’s who owns the decisions that are expensive to unwind later. What actually changes when backend work is subcontracted instead of owned.
